title: A design is a versioned durable aggregate that seats submit and read
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-8a6d6660c31c4e119f962d13e6f1505d (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-05). Dependency-free LEAF; children 2 and 3 build on it.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the design CONTRACT and its durable aggregate, plus the two command kinds and their roster backfill. No wrapper change, no mission change, no UI - those are children 2 and 3.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-20a6d1eb: `grep -rn 'design\.submit|DESIGN_STEP|designRevision' --include=*.ts apps/ packages/` returns ZERO. Nothing exists between the Gate 1 approval and the decomposition run; the compiler seat plans straight from the approved contract. The gap is real in both directions.

THE SHAPE: aggregate `design:<goalId>` with VERSIONS. A revision carries five sections - screens/journey map (journey -> screens -> states), data model (entities, fields, relations), API surface (routes, payloads), component list, non-functional decisions (auth, accessibility, performance budgets) - plus open decisions for the human. Profile is the controlled one: TypeScript web app (React, Node, PostgreSQL).

TWO KINDS, DIFFERENT AUDIENCES, and this is the design decision worth stating: `design.submit` is a SEAT command (an agent submits a design) and `design.read` serves BOTH seats and the operator. So `design.submit` is NOT in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS and is NOT MCP-excluded - it is the rare kind on this board that an agent SHOULD be able to call. Do not copy the human-only pattern from approval.decide/escalation.decide; copy the seat-facing pattern from planning.submit_decomposition instead.

ROSTER, traced from planning.submit_decomposition: daemon-command-vocabulary.ts (kind, capability, family, PAYLOAD_KEYS), daemon-command-families.ts (the per-kind flag block at :83-94), daemon-command-registry.ts (`entryOf`, :205-212), mcp-tool-allowlist.ts (design.submit and design.read are SERVED over MCP, not excluded - they go in the served rosters), packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts, and the GENERATED client via `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate` (never hand-edited; it pins GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST, checked at client-compat.ts:169).

TWO PAYLOAD-KEY TEST TABLES must both gain rows and are invisible to a grep for the kind literal in production source: daemon-command-vocabulary.test.ts (~:170-182) and daemon-command-registry.test.ts (~:197-203, plus the flat roster ~:283-300).
definitionOfDone: `design.submit` and `design.read` are published with the full roster backfill and a BIDIRECTIONAL set-equality test that enumerates the SERVED kinds from the dispatch seam and asserts equality with the advertised roster in both directions; verify by deleting each entry from each side in turn and confirming all four deletions go red.

Both kinds are SEAT-REACHABLE over MCP and are NOT in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS - assert that an agent-authenticated dispatch REACHES the handler, which is the opposite of the human-only kinds on this board. This arm exists because copying the approval.decide pattern here would silently make the design step unstaffable.

Three refusals with a closed code->layer map (the refusal factory takes no layer argument, so a call site cannot mint a disagreeing pair), each asserted with code AND layer: DESIGN_CONTRACT_NOT_APPROVED (no approved Gate 1 revision), DESIGN_SHAPE_INVALID (the exact-key section roster - assert an unknown extra key is REFUSED, not ignored), DESIGN_REVISION_CONFLICT (a stale expected version).

The aggregate `design:<goalId>` is durable and VERSIONED: submitting twice yields versions 1 and 2, both readable, and `design.read` returns the LATEST by default with the version number. Assert the second submit does not overwrite the first - a design whose history is lost cannot show the operator what changed.
The five sections plus the open-decisions list survive a write/read round trip byte-identically from a real store. Assert per section, not on the whole blob, so a dropped section names itself.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (packages/contracts and the generated client are touched, so the root lane is real evidence here).
taskRails: THESE ARE SEAT KINDS, NOT HUMAN GATES. `design.submit` must be callable by an agent over MCP; the human-only/MCP-excluded pattern used by approval.decide and escalation.decide is WRONG here and would make the design step unstaffable. Copy planning.submit_decomposition's seat-facing shape.
NO WRAPPER, MISSION OR UI CHANGE. Staffing the design step and carrying the design into the compiler mission is child 2; the Design tab is child 3.
NEVER HAND-EDIT the generated client: run the generator and quote the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST.
VERSIONS ARE HISTORY, not a mutable field: a resubmit adds a version and never overwrites, because child 3 shows the operator which version the plan compiled against.
FEATURES ONLY (inherited): no security-boundary or policy work.
